chassis.note: Width 17.15 inches (435.6 mm) is the drawing's top cover width, and the drawing's 18.32 inches is the distance between the rack ear holes. The height is the data sheet's 1.75 inches, one rack unit and the drawing prints 1.74 (the guide and the data sheet agree with each other). The depth is 6.55 inches in the data sheet and the drawing; the hardware guide prints 6.5. No net weight is stated, only a shipping weight, so none is given.

colour.note: Median pixels of the angled render on the data sheet (page 2, 'CPM-1600-2-ECA'; the DSM data sheet's renders show the same dark face): the front face #373b3e. THE DSM BACK PANEL'S COLOUR IS NOT SHOWN BY ANY HELD RENDER, SO IT IS DRAWN IN THE FRONT COLOUR AND IS UNCHECKED. NO PHOTOGRAPH IS HELD. The red printed bars and the red logo block the render shows are not drawn.

ears.note: The drawing shows an ear at each end with two holes (one round, one slotted) and the data sheet says '19 Rack Brackets Included'. The ear hole pitch is not dimensioned; the drawing's 18.32 inches is the distance between the two ear hole axes. The ears are drawn at the faceplate, so the shipped position is flush.

inlets.note: The drawing's main view shows two C14 inlets, A and B ('DUAL INPUT RECEPTACLE C14'); the data sheet says '(1) IEC-320-C14 Inlet' for AC models and the guide calls the second inlet optional. WHICH PART NUMBERS CARRY ONE INLET IS NOT STATED, SO BOTH ARE DRAWN AS THE DRAWING SHOWS THEM.

lamps.note: The lamps of both faces are drawn as plain discs, not as states: the hardware guide names them (port activity, plug activity or status) and does not state a colour or a state for any, so none is claimed.

method.note: THE DRAWING IS LINE ART AT ABOUT 1 TO 3 AND CARRIES NO CONNECTOR DIMENSION. Positions are measured on its vector geometry (a jack's outline, an outlet's box, an inlet's housing), centred on the drawn faceplate; a part is placed by its centre on the drawn outline. The drawn faceplate is slightly shorter than the stated height (drawing 1.74 or 3.46 inches against 1.75 or 3.5), so vertical positions are centred on the face. A lamp's spacing inside its frame is the drawing's. The captions inside the buttons, the lamp and port numerals, the ACT and LNK legends over the Ethernet jacks and the SETUP bracket over port 1 are placed from the printed positions in the drawing and are good to about 0.7 mm.

power.note: Data sheet page 2: '100 - 240 VAC, 50/60 Hz, 10 Watts Max.' for AC models. The DC models (terminal strip) are not modelled.

serial-ports.note: RJ45 RS-232 serial ports, eight (hardware guide, 'Eight (8) RJ45 connectors'), port 1 marked SETUP. Units ship with a standard or a straight pinout and which a part number has is not stated (hardware guide, appendix B), so the jacks state the media and no pinout.

serial-role.note: The ports are console server ports (hardware guide, 'Serial Ports: connection to console ports on target devices').

sources.note: NO PHOTOGRAPH IS HELD. Every position on both faces is read from the vector figures of the maker's one-page dimensional drawing (DSM family, revision A): the views carry no dimension for a connector, so each is a point of the drawing, converted at the scale that makes the drawn faceplate the 17.15 inches the drawing prints, and is good to about 1.5 mm. The hardware guide's front and back figures (CPM Series Hardware Guide figures 2.1 to 2.5; DSM Series Hardware Guide figures 2.1 to 2.6) agree with the drawing on the order of every connector. The colours are read from the angled renders on the data sheets, which are marketing renders and not photographs.
